config.design: Five task families x two constructions x eight items, nine frozen H632 probes. Fixed first four items of template0 fit task/global mean full-logit derivatives. All remaining contexts held out. No prompt filtering. Central +/- .02 responses; original/span0/orthogonal0 checked at half step. Original finite +/-.1 KL calibration.
config.limitations: Context-transfer baseline only; does not test unseen directions or fit low rank. First-token exact scoring includes explicit competitors; generic agreement continuation is not forced binary completion.
